candidate: V6 numerical settings and training method frozen from pairwise-study; no new candidate hyperparameter search
selection: Four configurations per baseline family; score every fitted tree prefix using the same low-FPR validation selection_key as V6. Select hyperparameters on seed 17 validation only. Repeat seeds keep those hyperparameters and reselect prefix on validation.
fairness: Matched baseline trial counts and tree cap, not matched wall time or model capacity. Native CatBoost and native categorical LightGBM; train-fitted shared numeric encoding for XGBoost and V6.

schemes.paysim: four published steps per time block

uncertainty.interpretation: Paired percentile intervals conditional on selected models and fixed calibration cutoffs. No multiple-comparison correction or general dependence guarantee; fewer than 20 clusters is unsupported.

holdouts.elliptic: First measurement of frozen V6 on a real known-label Bitcoin AML transfer target, not independent payment-fraud confirmation

elliptic_features: Local published positions 2..94 only; exclude transaction ID, time and 72 backward/forward-neighbour features. Unknown labels excluded. Source anonymization and point-in-time availability cannot be independently audited.

external_access.ieee_cis: Download retried this turn and returned 403; do not accept competition rules or bypass access restrictions.

reporting: Retain all budgets, seeds, regressions and prefix-zero cases. No algorithm changes or model promotion based on final outcomes. Real transfer task is reported separately; never pool datasets.
